Regional Economic Activity in the United States in the Early 1800s

The Northeast | The Midwest | The South
Produced manufactured goods | Supplied food resources | Provided raw materials

What was one result of these regional differences?

options.label: A
options.text: Cities in the South emerged as centers for textile mills.

options.label: B
options.text: Immigrants settled in the Midwest to establish small farms.

options.label: C
options.text: Slavery increased in the Northeast as industrialization expanded.

options.label: D
options.text: Plantation systems in the South were replaced by large businesses.
